text: {"lessons":["Selling Stocks E, D, and A at gains felt rewarding, but those outcomes do not prove that taking profits improves future results when prices are unpredictable.","I will not hold or sell a stock just to avoid realizing a loss or preserve a gain; I will consider its future prospects and its place in the whole portfolio.","After several quiet periods and a modest recent decline, I will avoid reacting to short-term account changes and trade only when I have a clear reason."]}
